spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns = 24 default, with stop conditions {solved, model_gave_up, model_stopped, max_turns}
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:42 max_turns:int=24; the episode loop `for turn in range(config.max_turns)` (loop.py:80) bounds iterations and defaults terminated='max_turns' (loop.py:78). All four stop conditions are enforced and break the loop: solved -> break (loop.py:124-127), model_gave_up -> break (loop.py:128-130), model_stopped on no tool calls -> break (loop.py:94-96), and max_turns by loop bound. max_turns is read from config in run_eval.py:147 and passed to run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced; loop iteration count is bounded and break statements fire on each condition. solved only possible on control tasks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cost controls: max_turns, max_tokens (on the client), early-stop on solved.

spec_features.spec_quote: a `give_up` tool exists and terminating via it is recorded distinctly
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool defined in TOOL_SPECS (tools.py:57-69) and dispatched via _tool_give_up (tools.py:140-143). In the loop, a give_up call sets gave_up=True and breaks with terminated='model_gave_up' (loop.py:131,128-130). Recorded distinctly: transcript.terminated_reason set (loop.py via terminated), give_up_reason stored in meta (loop.py:136), and the system prompt instructs the model it may use give_up (loop.py:35-37). terminated_reason 'model_gave_up' is read downstream (signals.py:209, degradation.py:158).
spec_features.notes: Tool is built, dispatched, honored as a stop, and the terminating reason is recorded distinctly from max_turns/model_stopped.

spec_features.spec_quote: stop_on_no_tool_calls` defaults to true (a no-tool assistant turn ends the episode)
spec_features.evidence: LoopConfig.stop_on_no_tool_calls:bool=True (loop.py:44). In the loop, when resp has no tool_calls and the flag is true, terminated='model_stopped' and break (loop.py:93-96); else it nudges and continues. Read from config at run_eval.py:148.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: a no-tool assistant turn ends the episode when the (default true) flag is set.
